summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd., a Taiwan-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that its wholly-owned AGCC Singapore Pte. Ltd. unit signed a long-term AI computing capacity agreement with a Singapore-based provider for resources in Indonesia. Aggregate contractual charges over the five-year term, if all capacity is confirmed, delivered and accepted, are roughly US$300-400 million, with staged advance payments capped at US$150-160 million; part of the capacity still requires written confirmation. No board recommendation, advisor or securities transaction is stated. Watch delivery, acceptance and funding risk.
